messages:
Alyssa (Product): Quick sync — we need a final check on marketplace joint announcement runway. Partner legal confirmed embargo window until 2024-11-05 17:00 PT. Who owns press asset drop, blog, and landing page updates? Please ping owners and status.
Jordan (PR): I can take lead on press. Will coordinate embargo with partner comms. Need final quotes by EOD tomorrow. @Leo - Partnerships do we have quote signoff?
Leo - Partnerships: Confirmed partner legal ok with quote template. I'll pull approved quote by noon. Also need partner logo in SVG and brand colors — @Sana R can you confirm we have the assets?
Sana R (Design): I have a compressed brand kit, but partner sent guidelines that require a small tweak to background. I can update & export SVGs today. ETA 3pm PT.
Matt G (Eng): Heads-up: marketplace listing requires a short integration checklist and a screenshot of console flow. I can generate the screenshot if someone triggers a staging run. Who can prod staging?
Alyssa (Product): @Matt G please spin staging run, tag logs. I'll coordinate with partner for a test account. Also need to lock final copy for blog (700-900 words). Jordan, did you want to draft or should I?
Jordan (PR): I'll draft the blog post and the boilerplate. Send me the integration highlights and any performance claims to vet. Also: embargo handling — set a CRON to switch the landing page from placeholder to live at embargo time.
partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace-launch-checklist assigned to @Matt G, @Jordan (PR), @Sana R — due 2024-11-05T16:00:00Z
Matt G (Eng): Quick note on integration highlights: please avoid absolute latency claims until we confirm across dedicated/dedicated+quant configs. I'll collect token-cost numbers by EOD.
Leo - Partnerships: For SI integrations we should list certified partners and 3 example configs. I'll compile partner-approved configs by tomorrow.
Alyssa (Product): Can we make a short owner matrix in this thread? I want explicit owners and fallbacks.
Jordan (PR): Press — Jordan (PR) primary, Leo fallback.
Sana R (Design): Assets — Sana primary, Leo fallback.
Matt G (Eng): Staging & screenshots — Matt primary, Alyssa fallback.
Leo - Partnerships: Partner config docs — Leo primary, Matt fallback.
Alyssa (Product): OK locking that. Final ask: everyone confirm you can hit the embargo timeline (asset + blog + landing live at 2024-11-05 17:00 PT). Reply ✅ or ❌.
Jordan (PR): ✅
Sana R (Design): ✅
Matt G (Eng): ✅, will post staging link when ready.
Leo - Partnerships: ✅ — will deliver partner configs and quote.
Alyssa (Product): Great. I'll send a calendar invite for a 30m dry-run tomorrow 10:30 PT. If anything slips, flag here immediately :pray:
partners-bot: Event scheduled: Dry-run (marketplace partner launch) — 2024-11-04 10:30 PT
Alyssa (Product): Thanks team — tagging final checklist for action items:
```
- Jordan: Draft and finalize press + blog (due EOD 2024-11-04)
- Sana: Final SVGs + hero screenshot (due 2024-11-04 15:00 PT)
- Matt: Staging run + screenshot + cost numbers (due 2024-11-04 18:00 PT)
- Leo: Partner quote + configs (due 2024-11-04 12:00 PT)
- Alyssa: Coordinate dry-run and final signoff (due 2024-11-05 12:00 PT)
```
Alyssa (Product): If any blockers surface, ping me and @ops oncall. Thanks.
